title: Group departures, part 4: seats left on the calendar, the lead and the quote; the manifest with pickup and rooming lists (CSV and PDF); seats-sold, tour-sales and extras reports; coach trips from the departure page
goal: Wherever staff look at a departure (calendar, lead, quote, departure page) they see seats left; the departure's manifest exports as a pickup list and a rooming list; reports show seats sold per departure and per tour.
why: Gap 1's visibility and manifest parts. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 9.4 and 10.

edit: backend/src/routes/itineraries.ts (GET /:id departure and seats fields only)
desktop/src/app/(app)/departures/[id]/page.tsx (Manifest tab and Create coach trips button)

steps: planner.ts GET events: rows with related_departure_id carry departure {id, code, status, seats} from one aggregate query; the calendar shows a seats-left chip ('12 left', 'Full', 'Waitlist 3') and clicking opens a departure drawer with a link to the page.

Lead page: Departure card (when the lead has departure_id or seat bookings): departure, seats held/confirmed for this lead, seats left on the departure, hold expiry, actions Hold seats / Confirm / Open departure; a 'Link a departure' action (RelationCombobox over open departures, filtered by the lead destination when set).
Itinerary page: when departure_id is set, a panel with the departure, seats requested and seats left; a 'Link departure' action (RelationCombobox) that sets departure_id and seats_requested.

manifest.ts and GET /departures/:id/manifest?view=pickup|rooming|full&format=json|csv|pdf: pickup list (stops in order with time and documents-check flag, then passengers boarding there with name, seats, phone, documents status); rooming list (room groups or unassigned, names, gender, room type, sharing notes, meal); full (every passenger field the agency collects; document numbers only for roles with travellers export).
PDF with the agency branding and locale (reuse the PDF helpers other documents use); CSV with a UTF-8 BOM for spreadsheet apps.

Manifest tab on the departure page: view switch, FilterBar (pickup point, room type, documents status), Export menu (CSV, PDF), 'Auto-group rooms' helper that pairs sharing passengers by gender and room type (staff confirm before saving room_group).
'Create coach trips' button on the departure page calling POST /departures/:id/trips (R145) and linking to the trips.

tour-reports.ts registered in report-registry.ts (category 'tours', roles admin, sales_manager, operations, accountant; requires feature group_departures): departure_seats, tour_sales, extras_sales (reads passenger_extras; empty until R150) as in design section 10, with date range filters and money in the agency currency.
Reports hub: a Tours group shown only with the feature and the agency switch on.

tests: backend/test/departure-manifest.test.ts: pickup list order and grouping; rooming list grouping; full view hides document numbers for a salesperson; CSV and PDF return the right content types; feature off 403.
backend/test/tour-reports.test.ts: seats and load per departure, revenue and collected from linked invoices, tour totals.
planner events include the departure seats summary.

e2e/departure-manifest.spec.ts: calendar chip shows seats left; lead Departure card holds seats and shows them; itinerary linked to a departure shows seats left; manifest pickup list export downloads a CSV with the right rows; departure_seats report lists the departure.
acceptance: Seats left are visible on the calendar, the lead and the quote without opening the departure.
Pickup and rooming lists export as CSV and PDF.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # 0 failed files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/departure-manifest.spec.ts e2e/calendar.spec.ts e2e/leads.spec.ts e2e/itineraries.spec.ts e2e/reports.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: group_departures plus the agency switch; departure cards, chips and report groups render only when both are on.
Desktop: CONTRACT.md; RelationCombobox; t() with en and nl keys in departures.json and reports.json only; RTL-safe classes; money and dates through lib/format.ts and lib/dates.ts.
Backend: no migration; exports respect role permissions; money through utils/money.ts.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 9.4 and 10, services/report-registry.ts and one existing report module, an existing PDF route (vouchers or invoices) for the branding helpers.
R147 runs in parallel and touches only packages/; nothing collides.
